game.title: Hi-Fi Rush
game.blurb: Rhythm action game where every move hits to the beat, from Tango Gameworks, released 2023-01-25. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Twelve Tracks
chapters.summary: The story told over twelve tracks, from Track 1: A Fresh Start onward, with its hidden milestones. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Stage Feats and Secrets
chapters.summary: One-off feats inside the levels: the transit rail, volcanic rocks, robots in need, announcement drones, Kale statues, Smidge and the HR investigator.

chapters.title: Vlogs, Chips and Upgrades
chapters.summary: Vandelay Vlogs, upgrade chips, Special Attacks, Life Gauges and the Reverb Gauge.

chapters.title: Combat and Partners
chapters.summary: Beat-hits, parries, Jam Combos, Aerial Raves, partner calls with Peppermint and Macaron, and stage ranks.

chapters.title: The Hideout and the Rhythm Tower
chapters.summary: Costumes, playing with 808, hideout music, the Wall of Fame, the Training Room and the Rhythm Tower.

chapters.title: Difficulty Runs
chapters.summary: Finishing every level on Easy, Normal, Hard, Very Hard and Rhythm Master.

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Hi-Fi_Rush
Fandom (hifi-rush.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://hifi-rush.fandom.com/wiki/Hi-Fi_Rush
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); only its Controls and Table of Contents subpages are written, so nothing was used. hifirush.fandom.com and hi-fi-rush.fandom.com returned HTTP 404; hifi-rush.fandom.com answers the API with about 35 linked articles, including "Track 1: A Fresh Start" to "Track 12: Curate the Future", "The Hideout", "Rhythm Parry", "BPM RUSH!", "Power Up! Tower Up!" and "Arcade Challenge! Update!"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 1817230 is "Hi-Fi RUSH". 22 of 71 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the story chapter, though the last ten have very low unlock rates (0.6 to 3.8%) and may belong to later added content rather than the story. "Perfectly time your take down of your largest foe yet in a musical finale" and the QA-1MIL face sit in stage feats. "Find and engage with every Smidge" and the HR investigator sit with stage feats too.
